aircraft_order_delivered_at_matches_stat.name: aircraft_order_delivered_at_matches_status
aircraft_order_delivered_at_matches_stat.value:
("aircraft_order"."status" = 'delivered' AND "aircraft_order"."delivered_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("aircraft_order"."status" = 'pending' AND "aircraft_order"."delivered_at" IS NULL)

aircraft_order_kind_terms_match.name: aircraft_order_kind_terms_match
aircraft_order_kind_terms_match.value:
("aircraft_order"."kind" = 'lease' AND "aircraft_order"."monthly_lease_rate_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "aircraft_order"."used_listing_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("aircraft_order"."kind" = 'used' AND "aircraft_order"."monthly_lease_rate_minor" IS NULL AND "aircraft_order"."used_listing_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("aircraft_order"."kind" = 'new' AND "aircraft_order"."monthly_lease_rate_minor" IS NULL AND "aircraft_order"."used_listing_id" IS NULL)

aircraft_type_era_dates_ordered.name: aircraft_type_era_dates_ordered
aircraft_type_era_dates_ordered.value:
("aircraft_type"."first_flight" IS NULL OR "aircraft_type"."entry_into_service" IS NULL
           OR "aircraft_type"."first_flight" <= "aircraft_type"."entry_into_service")
          AND ("aircraft_type"."entry_into_service" IS NULL OR "aircraft_type"."production_end" IS NULL
           OR "aircraft_type"."entry_into_service" <= "aircraft_type"."production_end")
          AND ("aircraft_type"."production_end" IS NULL OR "aircraft_type"."out_of_service" IS NULL
           OR "aircraft_type"."production_end" <= "aircraft_type"."out_of_service")

aircraft_type_prices_nonnegative.name: aircraft_type_prices_nonnegative
aircraft_type_prices_nonnegative.value:
("aircraft_type"."list_price_minor" IS NULL OR "aircraft_type"."list_price_minor" >= 0)
          AND ("aircraft_type"."monthly_lease_rate_minor" IS NULL OR "aircraft_type"."monthly_lease_rate_minor" >= 0)

airframe_in_check_has_terms.name: airframe_in_check_has_terms
airframe_in_check_has_terms.value:
("airframe"."status" = 'in_check'
             AND "airframe"."check_tier" IS NOT NULL AND "airframe"."check_completes_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("airframe"."status" <> 'in_check'
             AND "airframe"."check_tier" IS NULL AND "airframe"."check_completes_at" IS NULL)

airline_ceased_at_matches_status.name: airline_ceased_at_matches_status
airline_ceased_at_matches_status.value:
("airline"."status" = 'ceased' AND "airline"."ceased_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("airline"."status" <> 'ceased' AND "airline"."ceased_at" IS NULL)

airline_kind_matches_operator.name: airline_kind_matches_operator
airline_kind_matches_operator.value:
("airline"."kind" = 'player' AND "airline"."player_id" IS NOT NULL AND "airline"."archetype" IS NULL)
          OR ("airline"."kind" = 'npc' AND "airline"."player_id" IS NULL AND "airline"."archetype" IS NOT NULL)

node_heartbeat_engine_matches_role.name: node_heartbeat_engine_matches_role
node_heartbeat_engine_matches_role.value:
("node_heartbeat"."role" = 'worker' AND "node_heartbeat"."engine" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("node_heartbeat"."role" = 'web' AND "node_heartbeat"."engine" IS NULL)

npc_decision_route_pair_complete.name: npc_decision_route_pair_complete
npc_decision_route_pair_complete.value:
("npc_decision"."origin_icao" IS NULL AND "npc_decision"."destination_icao" IS NULL)
          OR ("npc_decision"."origin_icao" IS NOT NULL AND "npc_decision"."destination_icao" IS NOT NULL)

schedule_repeat_days_match_kind.name: schedule_repeat_days_match_kind
schedule_repeat_days_match_kind.value:
("schedule"."repeat_kind" = 'daily' AND "schedule"."repeat_days" IS NULL)
          OR ("schedule"."repeat_kind" = 'weekdays'
              AND coalesce(cardinality("schedule"."repeat_days"), 0) BETWEEN 1 AND 7
              AND "schedule"."repeat_days" <@ ARRAY[1,2,3,4,5,6,7])

used_aircraft_listing_slot_nonnegative.name: used_aircraft_listing_slot_nonnegative
used_aircraft_listing_slot_nonnegative.value:
("used_aircraft_listing"."slot_index" IS NULL OR "used_aircraft_listing"."slot_index" >= 0)
          AND ("used_aircraft_listing"."generation_index" IS NULL OR "used_aircraft_listing"."generation_index" >= 0)

used_aircraft_listing_sold_at_matches_st.name: used_aircraft_listing_sold_at_matches_status
used_aircraft_listing_sold_at_matches_st.value:
("used_aircraft_listing"."status" = 'sold' AND "used_aircraft_listing"."sold_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("used_aircraft_listing"."status" <> 'sold' AND "used_aircraft_listing"."sold_at" IS NULL)
